comparisons.peer_summary: The Corporation tracks modified loan performance, reporting defaults for residential and home equity loans modified within 12 months of $128 million in 2024 and $287 million in 2023.
comparisons.comparison: Both MS and BAC report on loan modifications, but they measure different aspects of the phenomenon. MS reports the volume of new lending commitments extended to borrowers who have already modified their loan terms ($746 million in 2024), indicating ongoing credit exposure to stressed borrowers. In contrast, BAC reports the dollar amount of defaults occurring within 12 months for loans that were modified in the prior period ($128 million in 2024), which measures the effectiveness and success rate of the modification programs rather than the scale of subsequent lending.

comparisons.comparison: Both MS and GS disclose contractual amounts related to lending commitments, but for different scopes. MS discloses $746 million in lending commitments for borrowers whose receivable terms were modified during the year. GS discloses $568 million in total contractual unfunded lending commitments specifically for those where the fair value option was elected. While both figures represent 'commitments,' MS's figure is defined by the modification event and borrower status, whereas GS's figure is defined by an accounting election (fair value option) and includes all such commitments regardless of modification status.

comparisons.comparison: Both MS and JPM disclose financial metrics related to 'lending commitments,' but they measure entirely different outcomes. MS reports the principal amount of new lending commitments made to borrowers who had modified loans ($746 million), focusing on credit extension to distressed borrowers. JPM reports net gains and losses recognized on the sale of loans and lending-related commitments ($154 million net gain), focusing on the profitability of disposing of these assets. MS provides a balance sheet/commitment volume metric, while JPM provides an income statement/P&L metric.
